name: Hyderabadi Biryani
instructions: 1. Marinate the mutton with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, spices, fried onions, mint, and coriander for at least 4 hours. 2. Soak basmati rice for 30 minutes. 3. Boil water with whole spices and salt; cook rice until 70% done. 4. Spread the marinated meat in a heavy-bottomed vessel (handi). 5. Layer the partially cooked rice over the meat. 6. Drizzle saffron milk and ghee over the top. 7. Seal the pot with dough or a tight lid and cook on high heat for 5 minutes, then low heat (dum) for 30-40 minutes. 8. Let it rest before serving.
description: Hyderabadi Biryani is a world-renowned culinary masterpiece representing the royal heritage of the Nizams of Hyderabad. It is celebrated for its complex blend of spices, succulent meat, and long-grain basmati rice, symbolizing the fusion of Persian and Mughlai culinary traditions.
